notes.text: Reading the input list: drums, bass, guitars, keys and vocals, with the instructions for this show.
Counting the channels: 12 drums, 2 bass and 4 guitars fill LCL 1-18, then vocals overflow to AES50-A.
The tricky question is whether "leave all faders down" applies to the busses as well.
The bus object has no index field; key order has to survive the schema.
Writing the JSON now, with provenance for each channel.
Kick needs phantom required? No, it is a dynamic mic.
Kick gets a 40Hz high-pass, as drums do.
Socket 25 onward are on AES50-A; the next free one is A6.
The Drums Comp compressor detail seems missing from the plan.
